constructor-arg.value: SELECT ID, CLAVE, DESCRIPCION AS PLAZA, PROPIAS, DISPONIBLE, ESTATUS_ID FROM AHORRO.AHPLAZAS_CLABE WHERE ESTATUS_ID = (SELECT ID FROM NUCLEOCENTRAL.NCESTATUS WHERE DESCRIPCION = 'ALTA' LIMIT 1) AND DISPONIBLE = 0 ORDER BY CLAVE ASC
UPDATE AHORRO.AHPLAZAS_CLABE SET DISPONIBLE = ?, USUARIO_MODIFICACION = ?, FECHA_MODIFICACION = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE CLAVE = ?
SELECT AA AS ID, AH AS CLAVE, AI AS PLAZA FROM PUBLIC.EB5932AF68CC951DB51EB5B0C8782F WHERE AB = 100000000004 ORDER BY AH ASC
